title: Intern-Decision: Efficient Multimodal Decision Making with Autoregressive Masked Language Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2610.22131v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Interactive agents repeatedly choose among a finite set of actions, labels, or ordinal outcomes. Generating a free-form response for each choice adds latency and complicates the interface between a model and its environment. We present Intern-Decision, a family of 0.8B, 2B, and 4B multimodal decision models that return structured choices and candidate probabilities from text and optional images. Our autoregressive masked language modeling objective places one decision placeholder per field in a complete assistant JSON skeleton. Ground-truth symbols appear only in supervision, while all fields are evaluated in a single causal forward pass using the backbone's native language-model head. The 4B model achieves a 90.02% unweighted average accuracy across seven evaluation suites, compared with 88.74% for Jev v1.13.0. translated_title: Intern-Decision：基于自回归掩码语言建模的高效多模态决策
translated_abstract: 交互式智能体需要在有限的动作、标签或有序结果集合中反复进行选择。为每个选择生成自由格式的响应会增加延迟，并使模型与环境之间的接口变得复杂。我们提出了 Intern-Decision，这是一系列 0.8B、2B 和 4B 规模的多模态决策模型，能够从文本和可选图像中返回结构化的选择结果及候选概率。我们的自回归掩码语言建模目标在一个完整的助手 JSON 骨架中为每个字段放置一个决策占位符。真实标签符号仅出现在监督训练中，而所有字段均使用骨干网络原生语言模型头，在单次因果前向传播中完成评估。4B 模型在七个评测套件上取得了 90.02% 的未加权平均准确率，相比之下 Jev v1.13.0 为 88.74%。对于在单个 RTX 4090 上包含三个字段的固定 289-token 请求，4B 模型的平均延迟为 44.16 毫秒，约 33……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Intern-Decision 系列多模态决策模型通过自回归掩码语言建模，在单次前向传播中即可输出带候选概率的结构化选择结果，其 4B 模型在七个评测套件上达到 90.02% 的平均准确率，并将延迟降至约 44 毫秒。
en_tdlr: Intern-Decision is a family of multimodal decision models that leverages autoregressive masked language modeling to output structured choices with candidate probabilities in a single forward pass, with its 4B model achieving 90.02% average accuracy across seven evaluation suites at approximately 44 ms latency.
